subject: Preservation request: SOC 2 SIG / IRP artifacts + postmortem deliverables
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@finsecure.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: audit-team@finsecure.com
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: preserve IR artifacts + SIG answers for SOC 2 review

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. As part of FinSecure's scheduled SOC 2 readiness audit we need a short preservation hold and a set of artifacts related to the June 14th degraded-auth event. Specifically:

- A runbook or IRP excerpt describing detection/triage/containment steps executed (redacted as needed).
- A compressed copy of relevant telemetry for 2025-06-14 (auth logs, token-issuance traces, and any short-lived key rotation events).
- Answers to the SIG questionnaire rows 6–11 and related sample evidence links.
- A short postmortem draft describing impact, root cause hypothesis, and mitigation timeline.

Can you confirm we will: 1) preserve logs for 90 days, 2) provide an initial evidence drop by EOD Tuesday (6/17), and 3) share the SIG sheet (editable) with our names in the change log? If any material needs legal redaction, note that in the spreadsheet.

If easier, please send a secure Drive link to the artifact folder and I will pull them into our evidence tracker.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Samantha Cho
Audit Lead, FinSecure Payments

Samantha / Alex — putting the IR runbook excerpt here for the auditors (redacted to remove internal VM hostnames). See brief below and attached "redacted-postmortem-draft.docx" for the narrative draft.

Summary (redacted runbook excerpt):
- Detection: Auth service alert triggered at 09:23 PDT (elevated 5xx and token-failure rate).
- Triage: Security on-call validated increased 401 rate; identified a downstream cache invalidation pattern affecting token validation during a partial push.
- Containment: Rolled back the last cache push at 09:51 PDT; applied hotfix to token cache eviction at 10:07 PDT.
- Recovery: Gradual mitigation completed and traffic normalized by 11:12 PDT; additional monitoring and token re-issuance queued.

Note: we removed full request traces and PII fields. Full raw telemetry is preserved in evidence archive; we will provide redacted extracts.

Marissa Cole
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
